title: OauthSessionTerminated
description: A subject's session ended. Operational because relying parties and domain systems act on it now, dropping cached state to match the back-channel logout the gateway delivers over HTTP.

subject_ref.description: Pairwise pseudonym of the data subject. Subject whose session ended.

session_id.description: Session that ended. Random, and not derivable from the subject.

reason.description: Why the session ended. Consumers MUST ignore unknown values.

provenance.description: How the fact was produced. Required on every event.
